About Us

Home / About

Prayag Public School

Prayag Public School is a pioneer institution in creating a unique educational system which aims at developing both mind and soul of the child, with emphasis on the all-round development of the student's personality.

We believe in inculcating creativity and entrepreneurship in students. PPS offers modern education at a very affordable fee structure with big results.

We have proved our successful existence and service to society, especially rural India, where India lives.
